entry.name: jit.gl.lua
entry.digest: Script OpenGL and Jitter with Lua.
entry.description: jit.gl.lua provides and interface to both OpenGL and Jitter through the Lua scripting language. jit.gl.lua is similar to the js object for JavaScript.
